purpose: Render and browse the bundled AWS architecture artwork with names, theme variants and provenance.
behaviorProvider: Manifest-backed local images and a native catalogue composed with shared controls.

component: Look up artwork by the manifest-backed typed name. Invalid runtime names render nothing; getAwsLogoUrl returns an empty string for an unknown name.
Keep original artwork in image elements. Use the manifest light asset and an optional official dark variant selected by the CSS theme mapping; preserve source colors and geometry.
Use the manifest name as image alternative text unless label overrides it. decorative produces an empty alternative when surrounding text already names the symbol.
host: Supply permitted manifest ids and meaningful nonduplicated labels; do not imply that artwork usage grants trademark permission or product endorsement.
Own authorization, usage-policy review and updates to the vendored asset release. Preserve ATTRIBUTION and checksums when replacing the artwork.

requirements.statement: Look up artwork by the manifest-backed typed name. Invalid runtime names render nothing; getAwsLogoUrl returns an empty string for an unknown name.
Keep original artwork in image elements. Use the manifest light asset and an optional official dark variant selected by the CSS theme mapping; preserve source colors and geometry.
Use the manifest name as image alternative text unless label overrides it. decorative produces an empty alternative when surrounding text already names the symbol.
AwsLogoCatalog owns local query, kind, category, page and selected-logo state. Search matches all query words across name, id and category; filter changes reset pagination.
Clamp catalogue page size between twelve and one hundred twenty, with a finite default of sixty. The selected logo can remain visible while filtered results change.
Copy the selected manifest id through the clipboard and expose success/failure status. Download links point to the local bundled SVG asset; no remote asset refresh occurs.
Supply permitted manifest ids and meaningful nonduplicated labels; do not imply that artwork usage grants trademark permission or product endorsement.
Own authorization, usage-policy review and updates to the vendored asset release. Preserve ATTRIBUTION and checksums when replacing the artwork.
Keep the frame and catalogue in iconography group tokens; genuine nested inputs/buttons keep their owning category. Do not recolor third-party artwork to match a project brand.

limitations: This vendored artwork family has an authored contract but no standalone generated API family; the public TypeScript declarations remain authoritative.
No new artwork, remote update, endorsement, brand customization or rights verification is supplied.
Source coverage does not certify visual, assistive-technology or trademark-policy acceptance.
